title: PurchaseContent
description: Purchase content: the heading, a description, the price as it is shown, a note (delivery, returns) and one action. One object is valid in every purchase layout (a panel, centred).

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

price.description: the price as it is shown

note.description: a short note under the action; empty: none

actionLabel.description: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set
